issues.current: Four colleagues competed in their own record attempts – and of course we filmed everything. None of the official world records were broken, but we got five videos and a bit more respect for the professionals. See for yourself how it went.
issues.suggested: Four colleagues each made a record attempt – and of course we filmed everything. None of the official world records were broken, but we got five videos and a bit more respect for the professionals. See for yourself how it went.
issues.reason: Competing in an attempt is unidiomatic and wrongly suggests competition between the colleagues.
